sutter-hill-ventures._readme: Identity merges for the Sutter Hill Ventures base (PRO-77): renames and second renderings of one company across the 1999 table, the 2004 to 2016 listings, the Form D issuer names and SHV's own ownership filings. Written 2026-09-28 before the first prepare.
